cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

mechanism: A uses a childhood answer-before-copying rule to obtain its sibling confession of disappointment before risking its own.
confusable: Not merely reciprocal sharing: A deliberately makes the pupil go first despite being asked directly.
comparison: Sibling cancelled celebration versus workplace humiliation.
seedUse: D112 Mum/birthday/crying/candles; S05 childhood copied answers and grading honesty.
